name: squidbrake
description: Change control for Claude Code: every command and edit goes on a tamper-evident record (which agent, what changed, who approved it). Risky ones wait for a person to sign off (dashboard, phone or Slack), destructive ones keep an undo, and the ones your rules forbid never run.

gateway_url.title: Squidbrake URL
gateway_url.description: Where your Squidbrake gateway runs (start one with: pipx install squidbrake && squidbrake)

api_key.title: Agent key
api_key.description: An agent key from your gateway (gw_...). The first start prints one; make more with: squidbrake add-key claude-code
